info.name: Auth0 This Endpoint Accepts an IdP-Initiated Sign on SAMLResponse from a SAML Identity Provider.

params.name: connection
params.description: The name of an identity provider configured to your application.

items.docs: The connection corresponding to the identity provider is specified in the query string. The user will be redirected to the application that is specified in the SAML Provider IdP-Initiated Sign On section.
